acceptanceCriteria.statement: HomeView.tsx carries a short comment next to the bordered div explaining why its border is dashed. The comment is source-only and changes no rendered output.

in.statement: src/views/home/HomeView.tsx: add one short comment explaining the dashed border, placed beside the bordered div.

observations.statement: The comment is a short JSX or line comment of one or two lines, written in the style of the surrounding code, stating that the border is dashed on purpose. It is verified by review, not by a test, because a comment has no runtime behaviour.

provenance.source: Owner rejected the revision 2 plan (gate record a5588506a5d6e6eea02de1f716cc79917a5d690d1d7032390ed924508908de1d). Feedback (quoted data): "Also add a short comment explaining the dashed border".
Feedback does not say what the comment should say or where; conservative choice is one short comment directly above the bordered div.

increments.behavior: The Home View bordered div renders border-dashed, keeps border-green-500, and a short comment explains the dashed border.
increments.doneWhen: The dashed component test passes, the existing green-border test still passes unchanged, the explanatory comment is present, the full suite is green, and tsc and eslint are clean.

verification.requirement: Review of the diff confirms a short comment explaining the dashed border sits beside the bordered div in HomeView.tsx and nothing else in the rendered output changed.
